class.name: MovementState
class.brief_description: Everything the simulation carries from one tick to the next.
class.description: Nothing here lives on the [CharacterMovementComponent]. That is the point: a tick is (state, input, delta) to state, so the same code can be run twice on one frame from two different starting states - which is what a resimulation is. A field kept on the component instead would be invisible to that, and would survive a rollback it should not have survived.

method.name: clear_base
method.description: Forgets what the character was standing on. Done whenever the floor is lost, and whenever something outside the simulation moves the body - a stored offset left behind would drag it back onto the platform it was just moved away from.

method.name: copy_from
method.description: Overwrites this state with another. [member extra] is deep copied, so the two do not end up sharing one [Dictionary].

method.name: duplicate_state
method.description: An independent copy of this state.

method.name: get_active_layered_moves
method.description: Moves currently contributing, in priority order, lowest first.

method.name: get_base_id
method.description: Instance id of the node the character is standing on, or 0 when it is standing on nothing tracked.

method.name: get_base_relative_position
method.description: Where the character stands relative to its base. Kept up to date for replication rather than to drive the movement, which uses the base's per-tick delta.

method.name: get_base_relative_rotation
method.description: The character's orientation relative to its base. See [method get_base_relative_position].

method.name: get_queued_layered_moves
method.description: Moves waiting to start on the next tick.

method.name: has_base
method.description: Whether the character is standing on something being tracked as a base.

method.name: set_active_layered_moves
method.description: Sets the active move list. Managed by the component; a game has no reason to write it.

method.name: set_base_id
method.description: Sets the instance id of the node the character is standing on, or 0 for none.

method.name: set_base_relative_position
method.description: Sets where the character stands relative to its base. Not what drives the movement - the base's per-tick delta is - but it is what would be sent to a client to place the character on the right platform.

method.name: set_base_relative_rotation
method.description: Sets the character's orientation relative to its base. See [method set_base_relative_position].

method.name: set_queued_layered_moves
method.description: Sets the moves waiting to start. Prefer [method CharacterMovementComponent.queue_layered_move].

method.name: should_reconcile
method.description: Whether a client holding this state would have to snap to [param authority_state] and replay. A mode change is never within tolerance, because the next tick would run different code and the divergence only grows. Nothing calls this yet; it is the decision a predicted client makes, and it belongs on the state because only the state knows which of its fields matter.

members.member: A mode's own state, for anything the framework does not know about. A [Dictionary] because Godot can already put one on the wire, so a mode written in GDScript gets persistent state without a C++ change.
Whether the character is crouched. In the state rather than on the component so that it travels with everything else a tick produces.
The name of the [MovementMode] running. Mode identity is data rather than an enum, so a project can add modes without this class changing.
World position of the body being moved.
World orientation of the body being moved.
Metres per second. While walking this is flat against the floor plane.
